reviews.text:
I made a specific request for a shot of Librela with ONE LOVE ChelWayne that necessitated a physical exam. It was clear in my appointment call that the only reason I was getting the physical exam was for the Librela shot. I took off of work, drove over, waited a half an hour to see the vet whose name is Jennifer Jones. (I understand there are other veterinarians there. Use them!)

Jennifer Jones either did not know why I was there and had not checked the notes, which is bad practice, or intentionally did not tell me that there was no shot of Librela waiting for me and my dog, who is in pain.

Ask for another veterinarian!
So much love and affordable cost.

Took my cat for a wellness check and was impressed by how knowledgeable and friendly all the staff were! I really appreciate the transparent pricing. $55 for a check up just can't be beaten and I can't reiterate enough how amazing and professional the staff was! I will definitely be sticking with this clinic.

I moved from FL and needed a new vet. I noticed my cat had a red irritated tooth and called for him to be checked immediately. I was so distraught, anxious, and incredibly nervous.

One Love calmed me down and talked to me like a friend. Pepper was doted on and thoroughly checked with care. I left feeling supported and calm. I cannot recommend them enough!

This place is the best, I have been bringing my dog Micky here for a few years now and they always took good care of her Even now she got bone cancer and they still make sure I get my meds for my baby, etc..highly recommended good staff, good energy, thank you all..

boarded my pet here for almost 2 weeks unexpectedly and it went very swiftly. i called everyday to check in which i appreciated, all he needed was updated shots and they provide food! you can’t beat that, great prices. definitely will be utilizing their services again!
I called to ask questions about my dog shots and the guy answer he is a ignorant man. I ask to speak to doctor he said no and hung up on me..this happened 5/4 at 913am. Very rude.

If you are looking for a vet that will show personal care and tender love to your fur baby, please go to this hospital. They are WONDERFUL! !!!

Sherry is AMAZING! My fur baby was not eating regularly and I tried a few recommendations on line. It was not as impactful. It pays to go to the professionals! Here’s why, they immediately asked me what she was eating, how often and many more questions. After it was all said and done, (full examine) I needed to switch up her food. Really? Uh yes. While at Chelwayne, I ordered new food on Amazon. It arrived next day and now a week later my fur baby (7/8 yrs old) is back to her old self.

Chelwayne, Sherry -  thank you!!!  Thank you for taking the time to see her, ask all the right questions and treat her with such wonderful tenderness. I wish human doctors showed this much care.  I wonder if they could be my primary Dr. LOLOL!!! Jus kidding. I think you get my point! Thank you!!!!
My dog Bella get the best care. The worker very kind and professional.

Love this place!  The waiting room is so clean and welcoming, it never smells like an animal hospital!  The staff is so friendly and helpful.  They offer discount package deals when getting your pet their necessary vaccinations.  The owner/veterinarian Dr. Jennifer Jones is so caring and understanding, she is so kind always willing to help when it comes to your pets healthcare needs.
I had to take my 15-year-old cat Holly to be euthanized and everybody was so kind.
Wonderful staff. Cozy vet clinic.
I like this veterinary clinic.  The staff is friendly and capable.   Your wait time to be seen can be a little long if there is a emergency.
To start the receptionist is very unprofessional they do not pick up the phone at all. And when you do get someone on the phone, you cannot talk to a vet to get any type of advice about your pet
Prices are great for the community its in

I wish they had Saturday hours.
It's more convenient for a working pet

I take my cats here. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. The staff really tried to make my cats feel comfortable and relaxed during their exam. I’m also booked for a dental and it was a very reasonable estimate. I like that they don’t recommend unnecessary treatment like some other places do to make more money.
The whole experience was great for my cat Shadoe Conaway. I have told everyone how clean,the office is ,the staff is experience. Wonderful Veterinary Clinic.
I love one ❤️ love veterinary clinic my dog prada love the staff...they are very gentle with her and always has a good vibe.  Thanks one love for taking care my fur baby.
Best Place ever for my Pup. Affordable and the staff is amazing.
My girl was spayed here, and everyone was very friendly. The staff treated her caringly as one of their own. She had no issues with her recovery process
The best vet on the planet for your fur babies 💕 …
Ladies there are very pleasant and professional.
A huge blessing for the neighborhood. Excellent and loving care at a very reasonable price. Serious about caring for animals at a realistic price point. Nice to humans too. Love the decor.
Very kind people!
